title: Asks warn when their anchor matches nothing
ask: When I ask about a part of the page that does not exist, tell me right away instead of saying it worked.

outcomes.text: jelly ask says so when --at matches nothing
outcomes.evidence:
$ jelly ask plan "Which order?" --at "#nope"
demo:plan v4: asked a2 "Which order?"; #nope matches nothing on the page, so it shows at the top

outcomes.text: The ask is still created; this is a warning, not a refusal
Without a browser, the reply says the anchor was not checked
outcomes.evidence: This machine has Chrome, so I could not make the no-browser case happen. The code path is in group "reply".

groups.intent: Check the selector against the page before answering
groups.why: Adds a headless render to every anchored ask: about a second slower.
groups.evidence: Ran it against a view with #list and without #nope; both replies were right.

groups.intent: Say what happened in the one-line reply
groups.why: Only wording changes; the event is the same.
groups.evidence: Covers all three cases: matched, matched nothing, not checked.

groups.intent: Test that a dead anchor does not stop the ask
Skill text matches the new reply
